decisions.reason: The source changes the qualification gate to one reference-matching clip, and the existing same-message MODIFY already captures that change, including the new clip count and success condition.
The existing same-message MODIFY already updates the composite role pathway to use the single corrective clip as the prerequisite; no additional Lead Clipper attribute is changed by the source.
Changing the immediate qualification submission to one corrective clip does not change the subsequent quota of 125 approved clips per month.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete three-clips-from-one-video batch constraint; the permitted source remains Teyron's content.
The instruction to match the provided reference does not explicitly establish or change an impactful-moment selection standard.
The source changes the qualification submission quantity and reference-matching task but does not alter the existing complete standalone teaching-moment criteria.
The source does not explicitly change the established caption color, font, or effects requirements.
Matching a provided reference for the corrective clip does not necessarily replace or modify the existing clean and simple editing requirements.
The source changes the number and reference target of the corrective submission but says nothing that changes the 30-to-90-second duration range.
